shellCommands.command: rg -l "cacheComponents" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js 2>/dev/null; rg -n "cacheComponents" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head; rg -n "cacheComponents|use cache" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js | head
cd /workspace && rm -rf .next && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30

cd /workspace && (PORT=3111 npm start >/tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && echo "--- req1 (ada/acme/eu):" && curl -s http://localhost:3111/ -H 'x-region: eu' -H 'cookie: member=ada; team=acme' && echo && echo "--- req2 (lin/glob/apac):" && curl -s http://localhost:3111/ -H 'x-region: apac' -H 'cookie: member=lin; team=glob' && echo && echo "--- first flush of shell (static frame before holes resolve):" && curl -s -N --max-time 0.4 http://localhost:3111/ -H 'x-region: us' -H 'cookie: member=bo; team=x' | head -c 600

cd /workspace && pkill -f "next start" ; pkill -f "next-server" ; sleep 1; grep -rn "export const dynamic\|export const revalidate\|export const fetchCache\|force-dynamic" app/ lib/ next.config.ts || echo "no route opt-outs present"
pgrep -fa "next" | head -5; echo ---; grep -rn "export const dynamic" app/ lib/ next.config.ts; echo "exit=$?"
kill 843 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; rm -rf /workspace/.next && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -12
